answer: When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 3 times its size, so a group of 62 keys loses far more than 62 single identities would. The terrace graph is rebuilt each epoch, and therefore the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the bridge audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the canyon checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. That is 11 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
